name: Manitoba farm concrete-block manufacture
description: A photograph dated 1904 documents concrete-block manufacture on W. J. McKinney’s farm in southern Manitoba.

date.basis: Date for the cited specific instance, not an invention or global priority date.

events.statement: A photograph dated 1904 documents concrete-block manufacture on W. J. McKinney’s farm in southern Manitoba.

evidence.supports: The historical society identifies the 1904 farm photograph and describes regional locally cast blocks as typically hollow.

events.caveats: The photograph caption does not specify the machine or material mixture used in this instance; hollow forms are described for the regional practice, not individually verified for every photographed block.
